lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior branchial region toward the caudal section, with higher density clusters on the upper lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like arrangement across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed lateral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the lower and central regions of the fin surface.
